blurb: I'm a senior software engineer and architect with experience delivering production systems for e-commerce, event platforms, and business software. I combine architectural thinking with hands-on development and refactoring.
about: Whether working on SaaS or on-premises systems, I focus on clear architecture, performance, and maintainability, supported by monitoring and automation.

I enjoy working in agile teams, discussing technical decisions, and questioning existing approaches to find sustainable, efficient solutions. I value ownership, reliability, and continuous learning, and collaborate with both technical and product stakeholders. Based in Lucerne, I work with teams across Switzerland and Europe, on-site or remotely.
I use AI tools, including large language models, to support development, prototyping, code reviews, and documentation, adapting my approach to the tool and task.
